clauses.guidance: Use this workflow only for issues and pull requests managed in an external forge. Classify each item as a bug or an enhancement, and state its user-visible problem and next action in English, before changing its labels or status.

Move each item through the triage states needs-triage, needs-info, ready, and wontfix, applying the forge label the repository maps to each state. The repository records that mapping in this guide, outside its setup markers, when it enables external triage.
Stop and ask the maintainer for the forge label of a triage state the repository has not mapped; never invent a label.
When an item lacks what triage needs, mark it needs-info, ask the reporter specific questions that name each missing fact, and stop triaging it until the reporter answers.
Start every comment posted on the forge with a sentence stating that an AI agent generated it.
Record each wontfix decision as a declined Backlog Entry whose reason cites the forge item, and answer a repeated request with that recorded decision instead of deciding it again.
Triage an external pull request as an issue with code attached: classify it and move it through the same states before reviewing or merging its code.
Route accepted work into the repository's local Spec workflow; a forge label or status never stands in for a Task's status.
